// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The whole-school headcount that decides the price band (ruling R10: "ops
// renders the price band computed server-side from bandForPupils"). Class
// carries no schoolId column, so a child reaches a school only through its
// class's teacher. This selects nothing, names no class and no child, and takes
// a school id as its only argument.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function pupilsOnRoll(schoolId) {
  return db.student.count({ where: { class: { teacher: { schoolId } } } });
}
